item.title: First look at the BMW iX3 Neue Klasse electric SUV with enhanced technology and performance
item.summary: BMW’s new iX3 – its Neue Klasse electric SUV – heralds the start of a bold new direction for the luxury car maker with key improvements in design, performance and technology. The iX3 range has been built from the ground up on a dedicated Battery Electric Vehicle (BEV) architecture.
